title: A tuple newtype is transparent in datom: read and written as the type it wraps
description: Witnessed by the Flow Nexus v1 work (Mind flowNexus): the generated contracts with datom-codec 4dff16b reject Launch.{ { Mind flowNexus Tertiary } … } at Topic (ethos Topic.String, emitted by ethos-zero since 6e41989 as pub struct Topic(pub String)): Form { expected: Struct, found: Bare } at path [1,0,1]. Failing Nix derivation 6zfphi5b0kj2ybvlxngaiddhn2na6cmn kept (flow-nexus-schema-tests, tests/datom.rs:45). Cause: crates/datom-codec-derive/src/lib.rs struct branches treat a single unnamed field as an arity-1 positional struct, reader l.106-118 (compose_positions needs Form::Struct) and writer l.197 (wraps in Form::Struct), so Topic("flowNexus") writes as { flowNexus }. Roundtrips hid it since writer and reader agree. vision:ethos: a newtype adds no braces in its datom form (variant payloads are already transparent at l.54 and l.145).
design: In both struct branches of the derive, a single unnamed field composes and datomizes as its inner type: Self(<T as Composing>::compose(datom, budget)?) and self.0.datomize(at); such a struct carries no Compositional/ARITY. A one-field named struct stays braced (only the tuple form is a newtype). Fix to stated vision, not held behind ethos-zero-add. Ordered by Psyche core Primary 0568e3 via Psyche core Secondary.
acceptance_criteria: A test parses the bare word flowNexus into struct Name(String) and { Mind flowNexus Tertiary } into a struct holding it, and writes it back to the same text with no braces; tests/core.rs NodeData<T>(T) (l.927) and tests/composition.rs l.270 updated; ethos-zero tests/generated.rs asserts Short("Ada") writes as Ada and parses back, and parses a hand-written Launch.{ { Mind flowNexus Tertiary } … }; the flowNexus schema tests pass. No wrapper workaround in the flowNexus repositories.
close_reason: Fixed and pushed as eb10157a0336e3aa2401e5b2046211fc8e736397 (0.32.3); ethos-zero generated regressions and pin pushed as 0eeb3df (19.0.1). Complete x86_64-linux nix flake check passes in both repositories. Original-derive negative witness /nix/store/vrmlw7l8k7583nlqmk87k3ymag6wqzgr-datom-codec-test-0.32.3.drv fails new external-form tests; fixed derive passes. Supplied bare Name, Address, Launch and no-brace writes covered, NodeData prints Data.7, generated Short prints Ada. Flow Nexus schema tests pass (6 Datom + 2 schema) with immutable fixed dependency only: /nix/store/jf1wlp4ag8czr8zravs5gw8pxhiykaf4-flow-nexus-schema-tests-test-0.1.0. Original 6zfphi5b0kj2ybvlxngaiddhn2na6cmn log witnessed failing at Topic. No Flow Nexus wrapper workaround; ethos-zero-add untouched.
